title: Resume Site
summary: A personal resume website built with server-rendered pages.
description: A single-page resume website that renders my experience, education, and skills from structured data. Built to learn server-side rendering and static generation with Next.js.

title: Task Tracker
summary: A small task tracker with local persistence and filtering.
description: A task tracking app that supports creating, completing, and filtering tasks by status. State is persisted locally so tasks survive page reloads.

title: Weather Dashboard
summary: A dashboard showing live weather data for saved cities.
description: Fetches current conditions and a 5-day forecast from a public weather API for saved cities. Supports city search and quick switching.
